correctness.rationale: A unimodular change of torus coordinates isolates a conserved Haar parameter and an expanding integer circle map. Nonzero determinant proves all two-time position laws are product Haar. Exact full-cell covering gives conditional iid for q dividing b. Conditional fiber mixing and Parseval give the stated long-lag word-covariance series, strictly positive if q does not divide b. The fourth-Bernoulli identity yields an exact rational form, and bounded-variation grid transfer gives the stated convergence bound. Independent exact-rational cylinder integration passed the listed finite checks.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete natural arithmetic criterion for Bernoulli versus persistent-memory behavior under all equal-resolution observations of this additive forcing system, despite universal pairwise independence of single-time labels. The nonzero long-lag two-word statistic and exact rational formula identify an otherwise hidden and mathematically motivated obstruction to mixing, not merely a routine change of coordinates.
